lifecycle_detail: Feedback received; developing the next release from 1 session
release_notes: Balls now leave the central overhead pipe with zero horizontal velocity and fall directly onto the starter E trampoline.
Trampolines are flat and apply a strictly upward impulse; bare-floor contact stops balls instead of rolling or rebounding.
Added a visible vertical drop guide and repositioned the pipe over the central play area.
Brightened floors, walls, workshop fixtures, and equipment using mobile Compatibility-safe lighting and materials.
Added mobile controls: left drag walks, right drag looks, right tap interacts, and double tap toggles fullscreen.
Expanded tests to verify flat geometry, readable materials, direct vertical drops, zero-horizontal trampoline launches, dead-stop floor contact, registered musical hits, and touch controls.
Updated browser smoke validation to require an actual trampoline-hit event instead of accepting emission alone.
`npm test` and `npm run build` both pass, and the web export is complete. Local browser smoke launch remains unavailable because the workspace blocks localhost socket creation with `EPERM`.
